explanation: Exact measurement membership, sample/participant links and recorded exclusions for the main Methods review (M01). Start with Cohorts and Analyses; filter the named roster sheet by analysis_id.

An acquisition is an LC–MS/MS measurement. A specimen is biological material identified in the producing metadata. Repeated acquisitions, fractions, preparations and participant-region summaries are not additional independent people.

Blank source identifiers remain blank. No specimen or original donor identifier has been invented. HS_shared_donor is an analysis label for the author-confirmed shared donor, not a recovered source identity.

The authors confirm that OnePiece, technical reinjections and workflow preparations came from one donor. The author-supplied protocol links OnePiece to longitudinal sample 2. Whether this donor belongs to Ind1–Ind10 is unknown; do not infer eleven distinct donors. Shared donor does not establish a shared physical stool across all designs.

August and later metadata are retained side by side. Each analysis uses its producing version. Later identifiers resolve three August blanks; they are not retroactively substituted into earlier patient summaries. Recorded visit variables are not interchangeable.

DNA and protein/metabolite specimens can differ within a participant-region. The native analysis joins layers at participant-region, not by assuming identical specimens. The 301-run upstream DNA processing roster also includes saliva.

Outside a saved roster is not evidence of assay failure or clinical dropout. Source-documented causes and reconstructed nonmembership are distinguished. Counts are conditional on the declared source universe; CAMPI is the retained 15-acquisition benchmark, not every acquisition in the original publication.

Roster size is not every feature-specific statistical n. Finite values, annotation and other endpoint-specific criteria still apply. CapScan membership contains separate entity_type rows; count the relevant entity type rather than all rows.

Sources contains exact inspected file locations and fresh whole-file SHA-256 hashes. Original source fields remain unchanged; analysis labels and joins are explicitly described. TSV copies, selection code and validation accompany this workbook.

Review checkpoint dated 24 September 2026. Frozen source analyses and the integration manuscript are unchanged. This package has not been deposited or published; final supplementary numbering and manuscript fusion remain separate tasks.
